contestRulesModal.title: Contest rules of the FO-KA Photography and Graphics Student Society

sections.heading: §1 General provisions
items: The organizer of the contest is the FO-KA Photography and Graphics Student Society, operating at the University of the National Education Commission in Krakow (UKEN), hereinafter referred to as the "Organizer".
The contest is internal and addressed to members and supporters of the Society.
Participation in the contest is voluntary and free of charge. The contest is non-commercial and currently does not offer any prizes.

sections.heading: §2 Conditions of participation
items: Participation requires submitting an entry with at least one photograph via the form in the contest application and accepting these rules.
The participant declares that the submitted photographs are their own original work and do not infringe the rights of third parties, including copyright and image rights.

sections.heading: §3 Submitting entries and voting
items: Entries are accepted within the period set by the Organizer for a given edition of the contest. After submission, changes can only be made by an administrator.
Until voting closes, entries are displayed under the participant's assigned nickname. Results are announced once voting closes.

sections.heading: §4 Copyright and license
items: The participant retains full copyright to the submitted photographs.

By submitting an entry, the participant grants the Organizer a free, non-exclusive license to use the submitted photographs on the Society's website and social media, for purposes related to organizing, promoting, and documenting the contest.

sections.heading: §5 Personal data and publication of authorship
items: The participant agrees to the publication of their first and last name as the author of the submitted work after the contest ends (once voting closes).
Until voting closes, the participant's personal data is not publicly disclosed — only the nickname is displayed.
The Organizer is the administrator of participants' personal data. Data is processed solely for the purpose of running the contest and publishing results in accordance with these rules.

sections.heading: §6 Final provisions
items: The Organizer reserves the right to exclude entries that violate these rules or applicable law.
Matters not covered by these rules are decided by the Organizer.
